summary_en: HIMARAYA executed a buyback of up to 1,000,000 shares (8.2% of outstanding shares) at 852 yen per share on October 16, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, with a maximum acquisition amount of 852 million yen. The transaction was decided by the Board on October 15, 2026 to enhance capital efficiency and support agile capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Negotiated Trades (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 15, 2026, HIMARAYA's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares of its own common stock at a fixed price of 852 yen per share through an off-hours negotiated trade (ToSTNeT-3) on October 16, 2026 at 8:45 AM. The maximum acquisition amount is 852 million yen, representing 8.2% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of August 31, 2026.

The fixed purchase price of 852 yen was set at the closing price (including after-hours quotes) on October 15, 2026. The transaction will settle via ToSTNeT-3, with results to be disclosed after the trading session. The company noted that execution of all or part of the shares may not occur depending on market conditions, and that the number of shares targeted will not be modified.
